chunks: And with this chain, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: As-Sadiq (peace be upon him) wrote to some people,
"If you wish for your deeds to have a good ending until you are taken (die) while you are in the best of deeds,
then honor God's right by not expending His blessings in disobeying Him,
and not to be deceived by His forbearance towards you.
And honor everyone you find who mentions us or claims affinity with our love.
Then there is no responsibility upon you, whether he is truthful or a liar; you have your intention, and upon him is his lie.

key_terms.إِنَّمَا لَكَ نِيَّتُكَ: you have your intention (reward is based on it)
key_terms.يُخْتَمَ بِخَيْرٍ عَمَلُكَ: to have a good ending to one's deeds

ai.seo_question: How can one ensure a good death according to Imam Al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This tradition from Imam al-Rida (via his father Musa al-Kazim and grandfather Ja'far al-Sadiq) highlights the Shia principle of *al-sabr al-jami'* (comprehensive patience) and the primacy of intention (*niyyah*) in social interactions. It instructs believers to honor God by utilizing His blessings in obedience, avoid complacency due to His forbearance, and show respect to all who claim affinity with the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing between the claimant's truthfulness and the believer's sincere intent.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 30-8 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Al-Ridha (s), on the authority of his father Musa ibn Ja’far (s) that As-Sadiq (s) wrote a letter to someone and advised him as follows, “
If you wish your deeds to have a good ending - so that when you die you have done the best you can -
honor God’s right and do not use His Blessings in disobeying Him,
and do not be too proud, since God is patient with you.
Honor whomever you find who honors us, and respect whoever claims to like us.
Then there will be no responsibility upon you, whether that is said honestly or it is a lie. You will benefit from your intentions, and they will be responsible for their lies.”
